explanation: The English Wikipedia article "American-Algerian War" (revision 1382319805) says: "Occurring after the U.S. became independent from the British Empire as a result of the American Revolutionary War, Algiers declared war on the United States after realizing that American merchant shipping was no longer under the protection of the Royal Navy." The edge reads that sentence as: American Revolutionary War was a precondition of American-Algerian War, and nothing more.
